name: Mezase My Home! ~Niizuma o Mamore~
original_name: めざせマイホーム! ～新妻を守れ～
source:
Rentaro is a salaryman. He hears rumors about a beautiful girl on a train, so he takes the same train. He meets Erika there and falls in love with her at first sight. Surprisingly, girl agrees to go on a date. But Erika's father refuses to recognize seriousness of relations unless there is a wedding, a house and a common child. Protagonist promises to become worthy of Erika in two years time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
